categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the consumer electronics industry, focusing on protective and functional products. Its business is divided into three main segments: environmentally friendly new materials and applications, lightweight new materials and applications centered on carbon fiber, and functional new materials and applications including precision die-cut structural parts. The products serve sectors such as personal computers, smartphones, smart wearables, new energy, servers, home appliances, and medical devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced materials technology including biodegradable, recyclable, and high-recycling materials, carbon fiber composites, and precision die-cutting processes. It employs innovative manufacturing methods such as laser cutting, automated carbon fiber weaving and cutting, thermoplastic molding, and pulp molding technology. The company also integrates AI technology in product development and emphasizes green, lightweight, and new material innovations aligned with ESG standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include terminal brand manufacturers, manufacturing service providers, and component producers in the consumer electronics sector. Major end markets encompass personal computers, smartphones, smart wearables, new energy vehicles, servers, home appliances, and medical equipment. The company maintains strategic partnerships with global consumer electronics brands and serves both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in regions including Shenzhen, Wuhan, Hefei, and Chongqing. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Vietnam, Mexico, and Japan, enabling it to serve Asian and global markets. Domestic sales constitute the majority of revenue, with international sales accounting for approximately 12%. The company is expanding its overseas footprint to deepen customer collaboration and market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of advanced materials and components for consumer electronics and related industries. It provides integrated solutions including protective packaging and functional structural parts, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing environmentally friendly and lightweight materials, expanding carbon fiber applications, and enhancing functional material capabilities. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI-enabled product innovation, new material formulations, and manufacturing process improvements. It emphasizes digital transformation, smart manufacturing, and collaboration with academic institutions and research centers, including establishing a subsidiary in Japan to access cutting-edge technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of protective and functional materials and components. The company operates on a direct sales model with strategic long-term contracts with major customers. It also engages in OEM production and external processing to optimize efficiency and cost. Revenue growth is driven by expanding product lines, customer base, and geographic reach.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading provider of advanced materials and solutions in the consumer electronics protective and functional product market. It competes with other specialized material manufacturers and component suppliers in the electronics and new energy sectors. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, strategic customer partnerships, and a diversified product portfolio emphasizing green and lightweight materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, representing a 21.47% increase year-over-year. However, net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 82.16% to RMB 20.46 million, impacted by increased costs from new capacity ramp-up, intensified competition, and higher R&D and management expenses. Total assets reached RMB 2.32 billion, growing 13.24%, with net assets of RMB 1.62 billion. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its commitment to green, lightweight, and innovative new materials that meet evolving consumer electronics demands and ESG standards. Its products offer multifunctional protective features, high-performance carbon fiber composites, and precision die-cut structural components tailored to customer specifications. The integration of AI technology and advanced manufacturing processes enhances product quality and customization, providing customers with differentiated, sustainable, and high-value solutions.
